xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1 The above financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2025 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 14th November 2025 and a limited review of the same was carried out by the Statutory Auditors of the Company

2 Considering the requirements under Indian Accounting Standard Ind AS 108 on Operating Segments the Company has identified sale of Steel and Power as primary business segments and accordingly the disclosures have been made As per this standard the Company has reported segment information as described below

a The steel segment includes production and marketing operations of Sponge iron and Billets and Rebars TMT
b The power segment includes generation and marketing operations of Thermal based power

3 3,828 18.75% Listed rated redeemable secured Non Convertible Debentures NCDs of Rs 1000000 each issued to True North Credit Opportunities Fund I and Neo Special Credit Opportunities Fund Mumbai are stated at reduced face value of Rs 518700 each NCD as on 30th September 2025 after part payment of stipulated mandatory and voluntary payments to the NCD holders during the quarter

4 During the quarter the company fully repaid outstanding balance of Rs 8430 Lakhs towards 1000 18.75% Unlisted unrated redeemable secured Non Convertible Debentures NCDs of Rs 1000000 each issued to Neo Market Services Private Limited and others

5 During the quarter the Company received term loans of Rs 11000 lakhs and Rs 4000 Lakhs from Kotak Mahindra Investment Limited and Oxyzo Financial Services Ltd respectively at an interest rate of 12.00% pa repayble in 14 quarterly instalments and utilised the loan proceeds for prepayment of high cost loans that is short term Loan Unlisted NCDs in full and part prepayment of Listed NCDs apart from using for ISRA requirement of these loans

6 During the quarter the Equity Warrant Holders have subscribed by paying Rs 321968337 towards subscription money for 49587272 shares against 82727272 warrants issued on 30th January 2024 and company has allotted 49587272 Equity Shares of face value Rs 1 each at a Premium of Rs 10 per share for an amount of Rs 545459992 by way of preferential allotment to various parties

7 During the quarter the company forfeited an amount of Rs 91135001 representing the application money paid by various parties against allottment of 33140000 Convertible Share Warrants in January 2024 but did not pay the balance subscription money to excercise their right for Equity Shares with in due date

8 SEIL Infra Logistics Limited a wholly owned subsidiary of Steel Exchange India Limited was incorporated on June 29 2025 and As of the reporting date the company has not commenced its business operations Consequently consolidation of its financials has not been undertaken for the current quarter

9 Other income includes interest lease rentals received gain on sale of property plant and equipment and miscellaneous income

10 Previous period and quarter figures have been re arranged and regrouped where ever considered necessary
